prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web app comp, landscape approximately 1440×1000
Primary request: Redesign the logged-in home page of “서울 촌놈”, a private travel-memory archive used repeatedly by one couple. Direction name: 계절 필름스트립. Past travel is explored as a newest-first succession of photographic strips grouped by season and month; title/date metadata stays precise and retrieval remains faster than visual browsing. Travel and day-out records are not merged; travel is the main body and day-outs are a separate secondary destination.
Input image: existing Seoul Chonnom screen, reference for warm-paper palette, restrained Seoul Pink accent, Korean workhorse sans typography and quiet product character only. Do not carry over its floating pill desktop header, narrow mobile-like central column, placeholder illustration content, or current layout.
Structure: compact flat desktop header with supplied SLCN mark area and only Home, 여행, 나들이, 달력 as primary destinations; shoes and Film Art live under a quiet secondary more/profile destination. Below, a concise heading “지난 여행”, a small “만난 지 653일째”, an understated rectangular search field, and a typographic year/month index—not pills. The archive itself is a vertical sequence of edge-to-edge photographic strips of deliberately different heights, never a grid: newest “속초 2박 3일” is tallest, followed by “부산, 비 오는 주말”, “제주 겨울”, and “강릉의 늦여름”. Each strip pairs one authentic-looking Seoul/Korea travel photo with exact date, region, duration and one-line review along its edge, like contact-sheet notation. Show seasonal separators “2026 여름”, “2025 겨울”. Information density changes between photo passages and compact date rows.
Style: calm, precise, mature production interface refined over years; warm paper #FFF8F8, ink #1B1B1B, white, Seoul Pink #FE9FC8 used sparingly, muted rose gray. Pretendard-like Korean sans throughout. Flat content surfaces, hairline rules, varied rhythm, photographic memory as the protagonist. No glass on desktop.
Constraints: readable Korean UI, actual app surface not a landing page. No 3-column feature cards, no card grid, no nested cards, no excessive pills, no icon tile plus heading plus description, no purple or blue gradient, no large gradient hero, no uniform section spacing, no decorative shadow, no glow, no glass desktop shell, no marketing copy, no metrics dashboard. Do not make filmstrip literal with sprocket-hole decoration.
